question: Give me a count of major hubs in each 10-degree grid cell across the world, highest first.
sql: WITH cells AS (SELECT ST_MakeEnvelope(x, y, x + 10, y + 10) AS cell, x, y FROM (SELECT unnest(range(-180, 180, 10)) AS x) xs CROSS JOIN (SELECT unnest(range(-90, 90, 10)) AS y) ys) SELECT c.x AS west, c.y AS south, count(a.name) AS major_hubs FROM cells c JOIN airports a ON ST_Within(a.geometry, c.cell) WHERE a.type LIKE '%major%' GROUP BY c.x, c.y ORDER BY major_hubs DESC, west, south;

question: For each major hub, how many other airports sit inside a 100 km circle around it?
sql: WITH hubs AS (SELECT name, ST_Transform(ST_Buffer(ST_Transform(geometry, 'EPSG:4326', 'EPSG:6933', always_xy := true), 100000), 'EPSG:6933', 'EPSG:4326', always_xy := true) AS zone FROM airports WHERE type LIKE '%major%') SELECT h.name, count(*) FILTER (WHERE b.name <> h.name) AS nearby_airports FROM hubs h JOIN airports b ON ST_Within(b.geometry, h.zone) GROUP BY h.name ORDER BY nearby_airports DESC LIMIT 20;

question: Compare how many airports and how many military-use airports fall in each quadrant around the equator and the prime meridian.
sql: WITH quads AS (SELECT 'northeast' AS quadrant, ST_MakeEnvelope(0, 0, 180, 90) AS box UNION ALL SELECT 'northwest', ST_MakeEnvelope(-180, 0, 0, 90) UNION ALL SELECT 'southeast', ST_MakeEnvelope(0, -90, 180, 0) UNION ALL SELECT 'southwest', ST_MakeEnvelope(-180, -90, 0, 0)) SELECT q.quadrant, count(a.name) AS total_airports, count(a.name) FILTER (WHERE a.type LIKE '%military%') AS military_airports FROM quads q LEFT JOIN airports a ON ST_Within(a.geometry, q.box) GROUP BY q.quadrant ORDER BY q.quadrant;

question: Map every 5-degree square that contains a top-tier airport, with how many it holds.
sql: WITH cells AS (SELECT ST_MakeEnvelope(x, y, x + 5, y + 5) AS cell FROM (SELECT unnest(range(-180, 180, 5)) AS x) xs CROSS JOIN (SELECT unnest(range(-90, 90, 5)) AS y) ys) SELECT ST_AsGeoJSON(c.cell) AS cell_geojson, count(a.name) AS top_tier_airports FROM cells c JOIN airports a ON ST_Within(a.geometry, c.cell) WHERE a.scalerank <= 2 GROUP BY cell_geojson ORDER BY top_tier_airports DESC;

question: For each 20-degree tile, tell me how many airports it holds and the best prominence value among them, where the lowest number is the most prominent.
sql: WITH tiles AS (SELECT ST_MakeEnvelope(x, y, x + 20, y + 20) AS tile, x, y FROM (SELECT unnest(range(-180, 180, 20)) AS x) xs CROSS JOIN (SELECT unnest(range(-80, 80, 20)) AS y) ys) SELECT t.x AS west, t.y AS south, count(a.name) AS airports, min(a.scalerank) AS best_rank FROM tiles t JOIN airports a ON ST_Within(a.geometry, t.tile) GROUP BY t.x, t.y ORDER BY airports DESC, west, south LIMIT 25;

question: Which 30-degree tiles hold the most military-use airports, and what are their names?
sql: WITH tiles AS (SELECT ST_MakeEnvelope(x, y, x + 30, y + 30) AS tile, x, y FROM (SELECT unnest(range(-180, 180, 30)) AS x) xs CROSS JOIN (SELECT unnest(range(-60, 60, 30)) AS y) ys) SELECT t.x AS west, t.y AS south, count(a.name) AS military_count, string_agg(a.name, '; ' ORDER BY a.name) AS military_names FROM tiles t JOIN airports a ON ST_Within(a.geometry, t.tile) WHERE a.type LIKE '%military%' GROUP BY t.x, t.y ORDER BY military_count DESC, west, south;
